suite.description: Identity Resource profile vectors (IDENTITY-PROFILE-01 §12.2 ID-05): the initial change, admission AI0 to AI5, per-entry state validation, pairing links, device fingerprints, the approval digest, rootOf tables and assignee display.

conventions.changes: Every change is made with time 0 and no message by the SHARED-OBJECTS-PROFILE-01 §8 actor of its writer in the Identity Resource I; the change.* cases give their exact bytes and framing; validation cases reference their causal history by case.
conventions.writer_class: inputs.writer_class is the class of §2.3 at inputs.control_ref, from the Control state of I in LFCP-IDENTITY-TEST-VECTORS-01.
conventions.diagnostics: A refused change or an invalid entry is PROFILE_INVALID with the profile diagnostic; a conflicted entry (§4 rule 2) reports the diagnostic of its first invalid value, else INVALID_FIELD_TYPE.
conventions.links: Pairing-link rejections are client-local (W §62): error.code PAIRING_LINK_REJECTED is a test convention, not a wire code.

suite.warning: All private keys in this suite are public test fixtures. They MUST NOT be used in production.
